terminals.name: convex-backend
terminals.description: Local isolated (anonymous) Convex backend for application state and integrations.
terminals.command: export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun"; export PATH="$BUN_INSTALL/bin:$PATH"; CONVEX_AGENT_MODE=anonymous bun run backend

terminals.name: web
terminals.description: Vite dev server for the React frontend on http://localhost:5173.
terminals.command: export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun"; export PATH="$BUN_INSTALL/bin:$PATH"; bun run dev
